conflictOfInterest.details: Founding-stage isolation check: the accountable principal VSBDev operates the authoring, review, and finalization agents, so principal-level independence is absent. Agent-level role isolation was strictly maintained: no authoring history, other review output, or adjudication draft was read, and no other EmbeddedKnowledge role script was run during this review execution.

findings.finding: The worked example in Scene 2 is exceptionally well structured, mapping out the task, what is given, the relationship, ordered execution, check, physical interpretation, and a self-explanation prompt (check-orders-of-magnitude-fluidity) that helps students reflection-check. This conforms with Section 5.1 of CONTENT-STANDARD.md.

The misconception repair sequence in Scene 4 effectively tackles the 'fluid-implies-uniform' model. It states the model to discard, why it fails (ignores 13 orders of magnitude transbilayer rate difference), details the replacement model, and tests on a clear discriminating case. This aligns closely with Section 7 of CONTENT-STANDARD.md.

Scene 6 provides a robust, scaffolded practice progression. Pass 1 models full reasoning, Pass 2 provides the first step and asks the learner to finish, and Pass 3 provides independent situations. This maps to the learning standard's progression guidelines in Section 6.

The assessment items in assessment.json show direct, precise alignment with the three lesson objectives. Each item requires active generation (fluidity directions, diffusion calculations, membrane separations, and transfer antifungal cases) and features robust rubrics, point allocations, reasoning details, common errors, and acceptable responses.

Scene 5 integrates the physical model of the membrane with the anatomical realities of polarised epithelial cells (the enterocyte brush border) and tight junctions, using the historic liposome fence experiment to build a coherent conceptual bridge.

limitations: Expert-simulation review: This review represents a single-pass advisory input by a simulated learning-design expert under standard-lesson-v3 guidelines. No real learner testing was conducted.
Conflict of interest: The same GitHub principal (VSBDev) is responsible for the authoring and review run operators. Agent-level isolation was maintained, but principal-level independence is absent.

Scope restriction: The review is strictly bounded to learning-design metrics (e.g. clarity, coherence, practice, alignment, and transfer). Scientific accuracy, rights audits, and final typesetting checks are excluded.

Technical verification limits: No rendered build environment, screen reader, or keyboard navigation pathways were evaluated physically; findings are based solely on the static Markdown and JSON source files.
